operatorProperties.code:
def process(load_sunspots) -> pd.DataFrame:
    from scipy.signal import find_peaks
    import numpy as np

    df = load_sunspots.iloc[:, [0, 1]].copy()
    df.columns = ['year_f', 'sunspots']
    df['year'] = df['year_f'].apply(lambda x: int(x))

    years_all = df['year'].values
    sunspots_all = df['sunspots'].values

    # Compute average period from ALL historical data maxima (no distance/prominence restriction for period calc)
    all_max_idx, _ = find_peaks(sunspots_all, prominence=20, distance=5)
    all_max_years = years_all[all_max_idx]
    avg_period = np.mean(np.diff(all_max_years)) if len(all_max_years) > 1 else None

    # Filter to 1960-2020
    mask = (df['year'] >= 1960) & (df['year'] <= 2020)
    df_range = df[mask].reset_index(drop=True)
    years = df_range['year'].values
    sunspots = df_range['sunspots'].values

    # Find maxima in range
    max_idx, max_props = find_peaks(sunspots, prominence=20, distance=5)
    max_years = years[max_idx]
    max_proms = max_props['prominences']

    # Find minima in range (invert signal)
    min_idx, min_props = find_peaks(-sunspots, prominence=20, distance=5)
    min_years = years[min_idx]
    min_proms = min_props['prominences']

    # Top 5 by prominence, then sort chronologically
    top5_max_idx = np.argsort(max_proms)[::-1][:5]
    top5_max_years = sorted(max_years[top5_max_idx].tolist())

    top5_min_idx = np.argsort(min_proms)[::-1][:5]
    top5_min_years = sorted(min_years[top5_min_idx].tolist())

    return pd.DataFrame({
        'avg_period': [round(avg_period, 2)],
        'top5_maxima': [top5_max_years],
        'top5_minima': [top5_min_years],
        'all_maxima_in_range': [max_years.tolist()],
        'all_minima_in_range': [min_years.tolist()],
        'num_maxima': [len(max_years)],
        'num_minima': [len(min_years)],
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Analyze solar cycles using scipy.signal.find_peaks with prominence=20 and distance=5 on sunspot data between 1960-2020. Uses iloc to access first two columns (year x.5 format, yearly mean sunspots). Computes average period from full historical maxima gaps. Returns top 5 maxima and minima by prominence in chronological order.
